info.title: Spillway API
info.description: The control plane for AI spend. One OpenAI-compatible gateway (`/v1/*`) plus a governance and administration API (`/api/*`). Request bodies are generated from the zod schemas in `@spillway/shared` — the single source of truth.

virtualKey.description: Virtual key `mk-live-…` on the data plane. `x-api-key: mk-live-…` is also accepted.

sessionToken.description: WorkOS session access token (human dashboard sessions) on the control plane.

adminKey.description: Admin API key `mka-…` for machine control-plane access. Requires `X-Spillway-Org`.
